name: labee-protocol-searcher
description: Search and retrieve laboratory protocols with integrated-Browser and explicit connected-Chrome fallbacks.

interface.shortDescription: Search protocols with safe browser-assisted retrieval.
interface.longDescription: Search protocol journals, vendors, and REBASE. NEB capture uses Codex's integrated Browser; explicitly authorized journal fallback can reuse a connected Chrome session without exposing cookies and caches publisher content as entitled full text.
defaultPrompt: Find an NEB protocol and retrieve it with Codex's integrated Browser.
Search protocol journals for an open full-text method.
Fetch a journal article, reusing my connected Chrome session only if native retrieval fails.
